title: Field notes
description: An original storyboard about making a useful change.

scenes.label: Observe
scenes.title: Start with what you can see.
scenes.body: Read the existing work. Name the problem and the evidence that would show it is solved.

scenes.label: Decide
scenes.title: Make one clear decision.
scenes.body: Choose the smallest useful change. Keep its assumptions beside the work.

scenes.label: Verify
scenes.title: Show what actually happened.
scenes.body: Run the result. Keep the evidence, explain the limits, and leave the next step clear.
